caption: A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed.
action: lifting a surface with something on it but not enough for it to slide down
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The glass panel must be securely attached to the frame with the picture adhered to its surface.
The suction cup must be properly positioned and activated to create a secure seal on the glass surface.
The worker must apply controlled force to lift the panel without dislodging the picture.
The panel must be lifted vertically and held steady to prevent any movement or detachment of the picture during the process.
